title: 第23章 怎么才能让我的剑插进去呢第24章 刚才爽不爽现在轮到我了
slug: 救了元婴宗主夫人醒后她急了
content_zh:
;;
双方距离不过三丈。
气氛暧昧得像是要融化这漫天飞雪。
陆长生正准备再说两句骚话拉近一下感情，顺便探讨一下关于“生命大和谐”的深刻哲学问题。
然而。
就在他张嘴的瞬间。
那种令人如沐春风的媚意，毫无预兆地消失了。
取而代之的，是绝对的、纯粹的、令人窒息的杀机。
刚刚都是好好的，怎么说动手就动手！
女人翻脸的速度，果然比翻书还快！
对面的女剑修动了。
没废话，没前摇。
上来就是开大。
这简直是不讲武德！
“唰！”
一道惨白的剑光，瞬间撕裂了漫天风雪，连空气都被这极致的寒意冻结，发出尖锐的爆鸣。
快。
快得离谱，快得让人头皮发麻。
如果说刚才她是温柔的水，那现在就是崩腾的雪崩，要将一切活物掩埋。
陆长生只觉得眼前白光一闪，那要命的剑气就已经贴到了脸上，鼻尖甚至能闻到那股死亡的铁锈味。

根本来不及思考，完全是身体求生本能的炸裂反应。
“卧槽！你不按套路出牌啊！说好的验货呢？哪有拿剑验的！”
他怪叫一声，整个人毫无形象地往雪地里一滚。
这招式叫“懒驴打滚”。
姿势很难看，四肢着地，像条受惊的土狗，还带起了一蓬脏兮兮的雪泥。
但胜在实用，保命要紧，要什么自行车？
“嗤——”
剑光几乎是贴着他的天灵盖削过去的。
几缕断发飘落，还没沾地就被残余的剑气绞成了渣渣。
陆长生摸了摸凉飕飕的脑门，指尖触到一丝温热的液体，后背冷汗瞬间浸透了衣衫，然后又被寒风冻成了冰壳子。
紧接着，身后“轰”的一声巨响。
他回头一看，眼角狂跳，心脏都漏了半拍。
原本平整厚实的雪地，像是被一只无形的巨手狠狠撕开，被犁出了一道深不见底的沟壑，足足十几米长，边缘光滑如镜。
这要是砍在身上，绝对是整整齐齐的一刀两断，肠子肚子流一地，拼都拼不起来那种。
“大姐，你玩真的啊！这哪是验货，这是要剁馅啊！”
陆长生连滚带爬地站起来，拍了拍屁股上的雪，嘴里骂骂咧咧，但眼神已经彻底冷了下来。
然而，女剑修根本莫得感情。
刚才的妩媚仿佛只是错觉，此刻的她，面若寒霜，眼神空洞，是莫得感情的杀戮机器，完全听不懂这种垃圾话。
“天剑诀·疾风式！”
一声清冷的低喝，仿佛来自九幽地狱的催命符，在这空旷的雪原上回荡。

女剑修的身影瞬间模糊了。
下一秒，她化作无数道残影，裹挟着漫天风雪，铺天盖地地压了过来。
那是单纯的速度极致。
content_en:
;;
The distance between the two sides is only three feet.
The atmosphere was so ambiguous that it seemed like it was melting the snow.
Lu Changsheng was about to say a few more saucy words to bring the relationship closer, and by the way discuss the profound philosophical issues about "the great harmony of life".
However.
The moment he opened his mouth.
The charming charm that made people feel like spring breeze disappeared without any warning.
Instead, there was absolute, pure, suffocating murderous intent.
Everything was fine just now, just do it no matter what!
As expected, a woman can turn against her faster than she can flip through a book!
The female swordsman opposite moved.
No nonsense, no forward swing.
Just open it up.
This is simply a lack of martial ethics!
"Uh-huh!"
A pale sword light instantly tore through the snowy sky, and even the air was frozen by the extreme cold, making a sharp explosion.
quick.
It was ridiculously fast, so fast that it made people's scalp numb.
If she was like gentle water just now, now she is like a rolling avalanche, trying to bury all living things.
Lu Changsheng felt a flash of white light in front of his eyes, and the deadly sword energy was already on his face, and he could even smell the rusty smell of death on the tip of his nose.
There was no time to think, it was completely an explosion reaction of the body's survival instinct.
"Damn it! You don't play by the rules! Where's the inspection you promised? No one can inspect it with a sword!"
He let out a strange scream and rolled into the snow without any image.
This move is called "Lazy Donkey Rolling".
The posture was ugly, lying on all fours like a frightened native dog, and he also brought up a pile of dirty slush.
But practicality is more important than life-saving. What kind of bicycle do you want?
"Tsk——"
The sword light almost cut against his Tianling Cap.
A few strands of broken hair fell down, and before they touched the ground, they were twisted into dregs by the remaining sword energy.
Lu Changsheng touched his cold forehead, and his fingertips touched a trace of warm liquid. The cold sweat on his back instantly soaked his clothes, and then was frozen into an ice shell by the cold wind.
Immediately afterwards, there was a loud "boom" behind him.
When he looked back, his eyes were beating wildly and his heart skipped a beat.
The originally flat and thick snow seemed to have been torn open by an invisible giant hand, and a bottomless ravine was plowed out, which was more than ten meters long, with an edge as smooth as a mirror.
If this was cut on the body, it would be neatly cut in two, and the intestines and stomach would flow all over the place, making it impossible to put it together.
"Sister, are you serious! This is not inspecting goods, this is about chopping stuffing!"
Lu Changsheng stood up in a hurry, patted the snow on his butt, and cursed, but his eyes had completely turned cold.
However, the female swordsman has no feelings at all.
The charm just now seemed to be just an illusion. At this moment, she had a frosty face and empty eyes. She was a killing machine with no emotion, and she couldn't understand this kind of rubbish at all.
"Heavenly Sword Technique: Gale Style!"
A cold low drink, like a reminder from the Nine Nether Hell, echoed in the empty snow field.
The figure of the female swordsman was instantly blurred.
The next second, she turned into countless afterimages, carrying the wind and snow in the sky, overwhelming the sky and the earth.
That's pure speed.
